stumbles.quote: names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn is never explained; a reader doesn't know what it is or why its tool replaces gh.
Unclear why these calls would 403 (session lacks permission?). Also ambiguous whether the guard denies them before the 403 or they return 403 first.
Subject says '/releases' and '/git/refs', but a POST to a tag-creating path like /git/refs/tags or a release sub-path wouldn't end that way; unclear if intended.

point: The commit extends the guard script so it also blocks `gh api` POSTs to the releases and git/refs endpoints, not just `gh release create`, closing a gap that let a session hit a 403.
